name: heb-tts-normalizer
description: Normalize Hebrew text for TTS: numbers, currency, dates, times and units become spoken words, ready for g2p.
author: thewh1teagle

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ../../crates/heb-tts-normalizer-wasm --release --target web --out-dir ../../bindings/typescript/pkg/web --out-name heb_tts_normalizer_wasm && wasm-pack build ../../crates/heb-tts-normalizer-wasm --release --target nodejs --out-dir ../../bindings/typescript/pkg/node --out-name heb_tts_normalizer_wasm && pnpm run build:wasm:tidy
scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:ts
